main.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO. Stock skyrockets 33%
main.summary: The Nvidia board said it had input from senior levels of the U.S. government.

related.title: Trump says he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
related.summary: The US president personally intervened to speak to members of Nvidia's board of directors.

related.title: Trump tells CNBC ‘I made the deal’ to reinstate Nvidia’s Jensen Huang
related.summary: President Trump said his administration gave Nvidia's board assurance that Jensen Huang would not be a national security threat if he was reinstated as CEO.

related.title: Nasdaq jumps 7% as Nvidia shares soar
related.summary: Chip giant up 33% after Huang reinstated while S&P gains 4.3%

related.title: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
related.summary: Huang stepped down earlier this month after revelations of at least two affairs, including with a suspected Chinese spy.

180029db4b.topic: Nvidia riassume Jensen Huang, Trump: 'ho fatto io l'accordo', Nasdaq +7%
180029db4b.reason: Svolta clamorosa rispetto al no del board già trattato: Huang torna CEO dopo l'intervento diretto di Trump, il titolo sale del 33%, il Nasdaq del 7% e i mercati globali rimbalzano dopo la settimana peggiore dal 2020.

main.title: Ukraine Attack Off Coast of Libya Shows Reach of Its Naval Drones
